title: DBMS I + PairCraft job queue (ScaleQueue inside)
objective: Relational modeling, normalization, indexes and query plans; build the sandboxed code-execution queue with workers, retries, backoff, idempotency keys and a dead-letter queue.
topics: Cloud managed services: EC2, S3, RDS, ElastiCache, SQS
B-tree/B+ tree, hash, composite, covering indexes
PairCraft: BullMQ workers, retries/backoff, idempotency, DLQ, Docker sandbox
theory: CMU 15-445 indexing lecture; Use The Index, Luke ch. 1–2.
practice: EXPLAIN experiments on PairCraft tables; queue build.
deliverables: PairCraft: runs submitted → worker executes in a Docker sandbox → result; retries with backoff; idempotency keys; DLQ
checkpoint: Read an EXPLAIN plan and pick an index

knowledge: Why do you need idempotency keys in a queue with retries?
practical: Invert a binary tree + max depth cold
Kill a worker mid-job; the job completes later
